description: updateDomainAutoRenew: Enable or disable auto-renewal for a domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, like "example.com", without scheme.

enabled.description: true to enable automatic renewal, false to disable it.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: updateDomainAutoRenew
